Looking into 2026, the Group is embedding Artificial
Intelligence (AI) more deeply into its operating model
to enhance decision‑making, efficiency and risk
responsiveness. Priority use cases include advanced data
analytics, streamlined Customer Due diligence (CDD)
processed and automated knowledge management.
The support for these initiatives will be the continued
expansion of the Group’s cloud footprint and ongoing
investment in cybersecurity capabilities ensuring that
scale, intelligence amd resilience evolve together.
